issues.display_title: Issue #23: Fix: Failed to Retrieve Review Detail by ID
issues.main_description_html:
Brainstorming FIle: 2026-06-09-fix-get-review-by-id.md

Context

There is a feature that allows users to view the detail of a specific review left for a photographer. This includes the reviewer's name, rating, comment, timestamp, and any reply from the photographer.

This feature was working before. After a recent code update, the client (frontend/app) stopped being able to read the review detail data correctly.

The update changed how the server sends back the review data — it now wraps the data inside an extra layer called review. The client was not expecting this change and therefore fails to read the data.

In simple terms:

Before the update, the server returned the review data directly. After the update, the server returns it wrapped inside a review key. The client still expects the old format, so it can no longer read the data.

Additionally, the format of the date and time fields was also changed in the same update, which may also affect how the client displays timestamps.

Goal

Restore the ability for the client to successfully retrieve and display review detail data by ID.

The fix should ensure the client receives the review data in the format it expects — either by:

  • Updating the client to handle the new response format, or
  • Reverting the server response to the previous format

Acceptance Criteria

  • When a user opens a review detail page, the review data loads successfully without errors
  • The reviewer's name, rating, comment, and date are all displayed correctly
  • If the photographer replied to the review, the reply is also shown correctly
  • The fix does not break the review list page or any other related page
  • The behavior is consistent whether the photographer is identified by their numeric ID or their profile slug

RESULT

✅ Fix Complete — Ready for Unit Testing

Client updated to handle the review-wrapped response format. Server response matches Node.js implementation.

Response shape:

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "requestTime": "...",
  "data": {
    "review": {
      "id": 1,
      "reviewerName": "...",
      "reviewerEmail": "...",
      "rating": 5,
      "createdAt": "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
      "updatedAt": "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
      "comment": "...",
      "isEdited": false,
      "reply": null
    }
  }
}

Files changed:

  • src/controllers/v1/review/getPhotographerReviewById.go — response wrapped in {review: data}, matches Node.js
  • src/action/v1/reviews/getReviewById.go — date format aligned to .000Z (matches Node.js .toISOString())

Client verified working with new format.
